collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — PONDERING HOW LIFE HAS GONE (LIF-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Adults of every age looking at their own lives so far: roads not taken, quiet satisfaction, small regrets, unexpected pride, things left unfinished, luck, gratitude and plenty of amusement. Nobody has to reach a verdict.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult aged 40 or older and another villager)

collection.description: A villager cannot remember why they were angry for a whole year: ask someone who remembers, or wonder about now.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has just remembered that, a long time ago, (subject.he/she) spent nearly a whole year being angry. Furious, really. At everything, all the time. (subject.He/she) stomped around, snapped at people and slammed (subject.his/her) door so often it fell off. And today, try as (subject.he/she) might, (subject.he/she) cannot remember what (subject.he/she) was angry about.

choices.label: Wonder What You're Angry About Now

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) wonders what (subject.he/she) is angry about now that (subject.he/she) won't remember in twenty years. There are a couple of things. (subject.He/she) tries to imagine forgetting them. It's hard. They feel enormous. But so did the pig, probably. (subject.He/she) lets go of one of them, just a little, that very afternoon. (subject.He/she) keeps the other. It might be important.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) asks (friend), who knew (subject.him/her) then. (friend) thinks hard. "A pig, I think? Or a fence? Something to do with a pig and a fence." (subject) is appalled. A whole year. Over a pig and a fence. They both laugh until they can't breathe. (subject) still can't remember the details. (subject.He/she) decides (subject.he/she) doesn't want to.
